content.text: Our experts independently review everything we recommend. (Courtesy of HBO)HBO's critically acclaimed hit series Euphoria returns this Sunday, April 12, for its third season, and it's been a long time coming. Season two of the show premiered in 2022, and season three will pick up four years later, with the show's core cast of former high schoolers now venturing into adulthood. Zendaya returns to the series as Rue Bennett, and she's joined by series regulars Maude Apatow, Hunter Schafer, Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, and Colman Domingo. You can also expect to see an impressive list of guest stars showing up in season three: Rosalía, Sharon Stone, Danielle Deadwyler, and Natasha Lyonne are just a few of the big names who will appear on the show this season.Season three of Euphoria will consist of eight episodes, with new episodes dropping on Sunday nights at 9 p.m. ET through May 31 on HBO and HBO Max.
